follow-up time: Until live birth or end of study
exposure: Paternal urinary concentrations of parabens and other phenols
cohort: 218 couples undergoing in vitro fertilization (IVF) and/or intrauterine insemination (IUI) cycles.
finding: No association was found between paternal phenol concentrations and fertilization or live birth following IVF, but higher paternal methyl paraben concentrations were associated with decreased odds of live birth following IUI.
